cohort: 138 HIV-positive pregnant women receiving antenatal care at Cipto Mangunkusumo Hospital from January 2013 to December 2018
finding: Early initiation of antiretroviral therapy (ARV) during pregnancy is significantly associated with reduced HIV vertical transmission.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly correlated with neonatal virology status.
birth_weight: Around 72.5% of infants were born with a birth weight of 2500-3500g
